metadata.release_note: Aggregate descriptive profile approved for public release. Rates include zero-use patients; hospital length of stay is summarized per qualifying admission.

window_definitions.1yr: Encounter date in [index - 1 year, index), lower-inclusive and index-exclusive.
window_definitions.5yr: Encounter date in [index - 5 years, index), lower-inclusive and index-exclusive.

metadata.rate_denominator_definition: All v2 cohort patients in the severity stratum, including patients with zero qualifying encounters. Each patient's distinct-encounter count is divided by min(obs_window, window_years), floored at 1/365 year, before patient-level rates are summarized.
metadata.los_denominator_definition: n_denominator is all distinct canonical inpatient encounters in the cell; n_nonmissing is the subset with non-null LOS > 0 used for the admission-level statistics; n_with_use is the number of distinct patients contributing at least one such valid-LOS admission.
metadata.specialty_care_definition: Canonical outpatient encounters with a nonblank DEPT_SPECIALTY outside the exact approved primary-care list, excluding exact 'Urgent Care'.
metadata.ed_inpatient_overlap_warning: ED and inpatient intentionally overlap on ED-IP, ED-OB, ED-OB-IP, ED-OB-SU, ED-OP, ED-OP-IP, ED-SU, and ED-SU-IP; do not add the categories as if mutually exclusive.
